name: pi-classifieds
description: Pi classifieds marketplace: Next.js frontend + Express/Prisma backend in one repository.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run prisma:generate --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run prisma:generate --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
